title: Revision Knee Surgery
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Assess the skin and soft tissue envelope, since multiple incisions limit what is possible.
Assess the temperature and the effusion, because infection is a cause of failure that must be excluded early.
Measure the range and record both deficits, since a revision often has to address stiffness as well.
Assess the alignment standing, since an uncorrected alignment is a common reason a procedure failed.
Assess the ligaments systematically, because a missed ligament injury is a common reason a reconstruction failed.
Assess the neurovascular state and record it, because that record matters before a revision.
